conversations.prompt: feedback isn't the same as having something to look at - what about the backfilled stuff that's in localStorage?
conversations.answer: If you want to view the backfilled results, you can create a section in your HTML that will display them. You'll need to create a new function to fetch these results from localStorage and then display them. This function can be called whenever you want to update the view, such as after backfilling results.In your HTML, add a section for displaying the results:[CODE_BLOCK_0]In your JavaScript, add a function to fetch the backfilled results and display them:[CODE_BLOCK_1]You can then call this function at the end of your backfillResults() function to update the view every time you backfill results:[CODE_BLOCK_2]You can also call this function in your initialize() function if you want to display the results as soon as the page loads:[CODE_BLOCK_3]
